channel.title: Moon updates
channel.description: Signed Moon browser releases for macOS.

item.description:
# Moon 0.3.5 beta
Smoother sidebar hover, in both directions.
- Tab hover backgrounds now use a short 100 ms ease-in/ease-out on entry and exit, rather than fading in and disappearing immediately. - Rapid crossings retarget the highlight while tab titles, close targets and selection stay immediate. - Reduce Motion keeps hover changes instant. - Native high-resolution icon compression reduces installed size to around 11 MB while keeping the approved Fluid Dusk artwork and small icon representations. - Moon's current browser features remain included.
Apple silicon; macOS 26 or later. This beta is Apple Development signed and **not Apple-notarized**. Sparkle authenticates updates; it does not confer Gatekeeper trust.
Connected Moon builds can use Settings → About → Check now. Older builds with updates disabled need a one-time manual installation. Source and MIT attribution notices accompany this release.

# Moon 0.3.4 beta
Fluid Dusk: a new liquid-glass gradient icon, a simpler Moon welcome and a smaller native app.
- The new Fluid Dusk icon keeps Moon's pearl, blue and midnight palette, with soft curved light fields and subtle glass depth. - Moon branding in About, onboarding and other product surfaces, with “Built by heyjoseluna” and “Inspired by Office Commun”. Required third-party license notices remain included. - Three-step onboarding with layout choices, optional import and optional default-browser setup. Browse now skips setup. Password import starts disabled, and browser discovery waits for your choice. - The production executable is optimized for size; Apple-silicon releases omit Intel slices from the update framework while preserving signatures. - Idle-tab snapshots run one at a time, with protection checks retained for active pages, media, downloads and unsaved forms. - Onboarding keeps keyboard focus and accessibility navigation within its controls.
Includes the existing anchored website translator, sidebar hover refinements, optional Liquid Glass appearance and signed in-app updates. AI remains local Ollama.
Apple silicon; macOS 26 or later. This beta is Apple Development signed and **not Apple-notarized**. Sparkle authenticates updates; it does not confer Gatekeeper trust. Apple Passwords pairing, restricted browser entitlements, third-party extensions and protected streaming require separate verification.
Connected Moon 0.3.2 and 0.3.3 builds can use Settings → About → Check now. Older builds with updates disabled need a one-time manual installation. Source and MIT attribution notices accompany this release.

# Moon 0.3.3 beta
A more convenient website translator, beside its sidebar button.
- A compact language menu opens beside the Translate icon instead of the far top-right corner. - One-click English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Portuguese, with more supported languages available. - Show Original, Cancel and automatic-translation controls remain available. - The menu keeps an auto-hidden sidebar visible, follows left/right placement, and is also available from View → Translate Website and the horizontal toolbar. - Translation stays on-device; macOS may ask to download a language first. - The extension-popup regression test now covers both scrollbar modes without relying on the host Mac's scrollbar preference.
Includes the existing gradient icon, subtle sidebar hover, optional Liquid Glass and signed in-app updates.
Apple silicon; macOS 26 or later. This beta uses Apple Development signing and is **not Apple-notarized**. Sparkle authenticates updates; it does not confer Gatekeeper trust. Apple Passwords pairing and restricted browser entitlements remain separate integrations.
Users of connected Moon 0.3.2 builds can check Settings → About → Check now. Older builds with updates disabled need a one-time manual installation. Source and MIT attribution notices accompany this release.

# Moon 0.3.2 beta
The current Moon design, with signed in-app updates and a drag-to-Applications installer.
- Minimal native sidebar, multiple windows, light/dark modes and optional Liquid Glass. - Full-gradient Moon icon and a subtle 70 ms hover highlight. Tab titles and close controls stay responsive during quick pointer movements. - Built-in website translation and Downloads beside Bookmarks in the sidebar. - Native WebKit browsing adapted from Search 1.0.7, with the Moon welcome page and local Ollama integration. - App Sandbox, hardened-runtime library validation, signed update feeds and archive verification remain enabled. - Signed update checks run hourly; automatic download/install-on-quit follows Settings → About.
Apple silicon; macOS 26 or later. This beta is Apple Development signed and **not Apple-notarized**. macOS may require its first-launch approval. Sparkle authenticates updates; it does not confer Gatekeeper trust.
Install this connected beta manually once if your older Moon build says updates are not published. Later signed releases can arrive through the in-app updater. A complete old-to-new installation is verified separately from feed and archive authentication.
Moon includes MIT-licensed code from Search. Source and license notices accompany this release. Chrome extension compatibility depends on the APIs each extension uses; restricted Apple Passwords integrations require separate setup.
